_note: The 2:44 cut, shot by shot (prep/video-script.md). build_video.py renders it; a missing file becomes a labelled placeholder, so the whole timeline can be previewed before the footage exists. Footage lives in video/footage/ (not committed). 'beat' picks the in-point from video/web-tour/beats.json. Keys ending in @template replace their plain key with --mode template. box = [x, y, w, h] on the 1920x1080 frame; crop = [x, y, w, h] of the source (a 16:9 crop of the console = a zoom). callouts = English html on the frame from 'at' for 'dur' seconds (classes in build_video.py Text.CSS); every quote is the bot's real message (src/teesri/texts.py) or what the run filed.
